selectedOriginals.caption: Courtyard of San Felipe del Morro castle, with a explanatory sign about the flags. Old San Juan, Puerto Rico
selectedOriginals.inspection: 2013 full original individually inspected: ochre-yellow arcaded main parade with white arches/pilasters/cornice and green lower plinth; open-court through arch, door/window openings. Flags, people and explanatory board are not geometry.

selectedOriginals.caption: Fort El Morro, San Juan, Puerto Rico, United States - Approaching the fort from the front
selectedOriginals.inspection: 2009 full original individually inspected: paired low landfront bastions, deeply battered weathered walls, southeast bridge/central pedimented gate; right-hand integral blue-gray lighthouse. Lantern is temporarily scaffolded in this date; exclude scaffolding.

additionalInspected.caption: Bartizan in San Felipe del Morro castle. Old San Juan, Puerto Rico
additionalInspected.inspection: 2013 full original individually inspected: cylindrical stone garita on projecting corbel, small narrow vertical firing slit, curving pale bell-shaped cap with small ball finial and rim. No generic conical watchtower substitution.

additionalInspected.inspection: 2019 full original individually inspected: paired stone columns, classical triangular pediment/entablature, shallow ornament/coat-of-arms area, true round-headed sallyport passage through thick landfront wall. Unrelated signs/people and exact inscription excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Photo from 5th level of El Morro looking out into the harbour.

scope: El Morro's tiered coastal fort, bastions, sentry boxes, lighthouse and principal ramps as a coordinated bounded site.
limitations: Outer native footprint is an approximate low-zoom mapped fort perimeter, not each tier or a construction survey.8m map tag must not become a uniform extrusion.
Local plan uses east/south signed axes. Lighthouse POI is an approximate horizontal control; actual base outline comes from inspected HABS/current photo evidence.
Independent current USGS D24 catalog labels vertical datum NAVD88; source-specific vertical metadata remains unverified. No datum transformation or absolute-level survey claim.
Original F32 export has empty sparse offshore blocks beyond the fixed256m review square; no source value is substituted/filled. All256m square samples must lie in nonempty original blocks.
Fine current materials/alterations and historical drawing dates must be distinguished.
